AUTO.description: Application is approved immediately upon submission without human review
AUTO.use_case: Employee batch issuance, low-risk credentials, pre-verified applicants

EXTERNAL.description: Approval decision is delegated to an external system via callback. Flow execution pauses at the approval_decision step until the external system POSTs a decision.
EXTERNAL.use_case: Third-party background checks, government identity proofing, enterprise HR systems

MANUAL.description: A human reviewer must explicitly approve or reject the application
MANUAL.use_case: High-assurance credentials, immigration documents, privileged access

RULES_BASED.description: Automated rules engine evaluates the application; routes to MANUAL on rule mismatch
RULES_BASED.requires: approval_policy_set_id must reference an ACTIVE APPROVAL_RULES PolicySet
RULES_BASED.use_case: Age verification, professional credentials, jurisdiction-based eligibility

enums__approval_strategies.description: How credential applications are reviewed and approved

EMAIL.delivery: Asynchronous; no delivery guarantee beyond SMTP acceptance

FCM.delivery: Asynchronous push; device must be registered with FCM token
FCM.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging — push notifications for iOS and Android

SMS.use_case: Fallback for mobile; OTP codes; critical alerts

SSE.delivery: Long-lived HTTP connection; events pushed from server to browser

WEBHOOK.delivery: Synchronous HTTP POST; receiving server must return 2xx

standards: W3C VC Data Model v1.1 / v2.0
VC_JWT.typical_use: Open Badges v3, enterprise credentials, OID4VCI generic

VDS_NC.description: ICAO Visible Digital Seal for Non-Constrained Environments encoded as a signed 2D barcode
VDS_NC.typical_use: Digitally signed travel and public-health documents represented as printable barcodes

ZK_MDOC.description: Zero-knowledge mDoc — ISO/IEC 18013-5 mDoc extended with zero-knowledge proof capabilities

IN_PROGRESS.description: Active execution; a step is running.

physical_document_issuance.description: ICAO 9303 ePassport booklet issuance with chip personalization.

OID4VCI_AUTH_CODE.flow: Holder authenticates with issuer via OAuth authorization code flow before receiving credential.

OID4VCI_PRE_AUTH.description: OpenID for Verifiable Credential Issuance — Pre-Authorized Code Flow

DESTINATION_ACCEPTED.description: The protocol-defined final destination accepted the message, such as a successful webhook endpoint

NONE.description: No acceptance or delivery receipt was established

PROVIDER_ACCEPTED.description: A push or messaging provider accepted the message

RECIPIENT_DELIVERED.description: A channel-specific delivery receipt confirmed recipient or device delivery

TRANSPORT_ACCEPTED.description: A transport relay accepted responsibility, such as SMTP DATA acceptance

UNKNOWN.description: The attempt outcome is ambiguous, for example after loss of acknowledgement

ALWAYS.description: Live revocation check required on every verification. No caching permitted.

CACHED.description: Accept cached revocation result within cache_ttl_seconds. A live check is performed when the cache entry expires.

DISABLED.description: Revocation not configured for this profile. No revocation check is performed. MUST NOT be used for credentials with compliance_code ICAO_DTC, AAMVA_MDL, or EUDI_PID. Distinct from RevocationCheckMode.SKIP (revocation-check-modes.json) which governs failure behavior during a check — DISABLED means no check is attempted.

OFFLINE_GRACE.description: Accept last known revocation status within offline_grace_seconds. Used for offline/proximity scenarios.

enums__revocation_timing_modes.description: Check-timing behavior for revocation during credential verification. Used in RevocationProfile.check_mode. Distinct from RevocationCheckMode (revocation-check-modes.json) which governs failure behavior in TrustProfile.

approval_policy_set_id.description: Reference to an ACTIVE PolicySet with policy_type APPROVAL_RULES. Required when approval_strategy is RULES_BASED.

credential_template_id.description: Credential Template populated before activation. The referenced template must be ACTIVE and belong to the same organization.

api.description: Declarative HTTP API call used to create this evidence fact when no custom adapter is required.

secret_headers.description: Header name to deployment secret/env-var name mappings. Secret values are resolved at runtime and are not stored in facts.

auto_issue_on_permit.description: Whether a permit decision may automatically approve and issue after this requirement is satisfied.

expected_response.description: Expected HTTP status codes and JSON/path conditions that must hold before the response is treated as verified.

fact_type.description: Normalized fact type required by policy, for example canvas.course_completion.

freshness.description: Optional freshness constraints for when the fact was created or verified.

manual_fallback.description: Whether this requirement may be satisfied by manual review if provider evidence is unavailable.

pass_rule.description: Optional provider-neutral pass rule evaluated by the fact layer before policy context is built.

provider.description: Provider namespace expected to produce the fact, for example canvas.

response_mapping.description: Mapping from the provider response into EvidenceFact provider, fact_type, subject_id, scope, assertion, verification, and source metadata.

scope.description: Required fact scope keys such as course_id, assignment_id, quiz_id, or module_id.

verification_method.description: Expected verification method, for example SIGNED_WEBHOOK, REST_PULL, LTI_CLAIM, or INSTRUCTOR_APPROVAL.

schemas__application_template.title: ApplicationTemplate

schemas__compliance_profile.description: Abstraction of credential format complexity behind compliance-oriented identifiers

api_surface.description: Runtime API endpoints that implementations MUST expose when this compliance profile is active. Allows standards-specific APIs (OID4VCI well-known, mDL device engagement) to be declared by the profile rather than hardcoded.

auth_required.description: Whether this endpoint requires authentication. Wallet-facing endpoints are typically false.

discoverable.description: Whether this endpoint is included in /.well-known/mip-configuration.

path_template.description: Path template using {org_id} and {deployment_id} tokens. May be a well-known path.

rel.description: IANA link relation or MIP-defined endpoint identifier (e.g., openid-credential-issuer, oauth-authorization-server, mdl-device-engagement)

response_schema_ref.description: JSON Schema $id of the expected response schema

standard_ref.description: Standards citation for this endpoint (e.g., OID4VCI §11.2.2, ISO 18013-5 §8.3.1)

discoverable.description: Whether this compliance profile appears in /.well-known/mip-configuration

holder_binding_required.description: Whether credentials governed by this profile require issuance-time holder binding and holder-bound verification.

id.description: UUID for organization profiles or stable cp-*/cpf-* identifier for system profiles.

trust_profile_constraints.description: Declares which Trust Profile configurations are compatible with this compliance code. Implementations use these constraints to validate that a CredentialTemplate pairs a compatible ComplianceProfile and TrustProfile.

compatible_profile_types.description: The TrustProfile.profile_type values that provide a trust registry suitable for this compliance code. Example: AAMVA_MDL requires ['AAMVA', 'CUSTOM']; EUDI_PID and EUDI_MDL both accept ['EUDI', 'CUSTOM']. CUSTOM is always a valid fallback.

required_formats.description: Credential formats that MUST appear in TrustProfile.supported_formats for compatibility.

required_source_types.description: TrustSource.source_type values that MUST appear in the linked TrustProfile. Example: ICAO_DTC requires at least one PKD_URL or ROOT_CA source.

verification_policy_set_id.description: Reference to a PolicySet (policy_type=CREDENTIAL_VERIFICATION) containing Cedar policies that define default verification constraints for this compliance profile (e.g., required formats, holder binding, algorithm restrictions).

schemas__compliance_profile.title: ComplianceProfile

schemas__credential_renewal_offer_respon.description: Public wallet handoff produced for an eligible issued-credential renewal.
schemas__credential_renewal_offer_respon.title: CredentialRenewalOfferResponse

allOf.$comment: vct is required when compliance profile format is SD_JWT_VC. Since we cannot resolve the compliance_profile_id dynamically in JSON Schema, implementations MUST enforce this rule at the application layer.
ISO mdoc templates identify their wire document type explicitly; this preserves mdoc functionality without exposing any signing-custody selector.

Inline compliance profiles are forbidden. A Credential Template MUST reference a Compliance Profile by compliance_profile_id (UUID). Embedding a compliance profile object in the template body is not permitted.

schemas__credential_template.description: Public issuance configuration combining claims, compliance, issuer DID, and validity rules. Custody and signing-profile metadata are resolved internally from the organization and issuer DID.

credential_payload_format.description: Explicit payload encoding format. If set, MUST be consistent with the credential_format of the referenced compliance profile; may not be overridden to a different format family.

credential_type.description: PascalCase semantic type identifier, or the reverse-domain document type for ISO mdoc templates

doctype.description: ISO/IEC 18013-5 document type. REQUIRED when credential_payload_format is MDOC.

vct.description: Verifiable Credential Type string. REQUIRED when the governing compliance profile specifies credential_format = SD_JWT_VC. MUST be a URI or a collision-resistant string. Per IETF SD-JWT-VC §3.2.2.

schemas__credential_template.title: CredentialTemplate

schemas__delivery_destination_profile.description: A delivery destination describes where an issued credential can be delivered, opened, imported, or mirrored. Unlike WalletProfile, it can represent holder wallets, learner-owned backpacks, organization-managed mirrors such as Canvas Credentials, or custom delivery channels.

claim_projection_policy.description: Rules for which claims or badge fields may be sent to this destination. Organization mirrors should use explicit projection policies rather than forwarding the full credential payload.

connector_id.description: Optional configured connector id for organization-owned destinations.

connector_type.description: Optional connector kind required to operate this destination, for example canvas_platform.

is_system.description: True for built-in destination profiles maintained by the MIP implementation.

organization_id.description: Organization that configured this destination. Null for system-provided destination profiles.

requires_consent.description: Whether the holder must opt in before this destination receives the issued credential.

setup_requirements.description: Human-readable setup requirements or capability flags needed before this destination can be used.

wallet_profile_id.description: Optional WalletProfile or wallet-registry id when the destination is also a holder wallet.

schemas__delivery_destination_profile.title: DeliveryDestinationProfile

schemas__deployment_profile.description: Runtime configuration for a physical or logical identity verification endpoint. Packages trust, policies, issuance capability, network mode, user experience, and device grouping via Lanes.

audit_all_events.description: Log every verification and issuance event from this deployment for audit purposes

biometric_required.description: Deprecated compatibility alias for operator_biometric_authentication_required. It never represents credential-holder biometric matching.

credential_template_ids.description: Enabled credential templates for issuance-capable deployments.

enabled_flow_ids.description: IDs of Flow entities that are active at this deployment. A Flow can reference multiple DeploymentProfiles via its deployment_profile_ids.

environment_config.description: User experience and offline behavior configuration for the deployed client.

lanes.description: Read-only in the profile body. Lanes are created and managed via sub-resource: POST /v1/identity/deployment-profiles/{id}/lanes

offline_cache_ttl_hours.description: Hours to cache trust anchors and status lists when network_mode is OFFLINE or HYBRID

operator_biometric_authentication_requir.description: Require the operator to authenticate with biometric before processing verifications

presentation_policy_ids.description: Enabled presentation policies available to this deployment.

site_id.description: Optional site/location identifier (e.g. airport IATA code, building ID)

trust_profile_id.description: Trust configuration reference used by this deployment profile.

schemas__didcomm_delivery_response.title: DidcommDeliveryResponse

application_id.description: Source application if issued via application_approval_issuance flow

can_renew.description: Server-derived renewal readiness for this credential.

credential_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the issued credential for audit trail

credential_id.description: Globally unique credential identifier, e.g. urn:uuid:... or issuer-defined URI

issuer_did.description: Public issuer identity. Custody and issuer-profile selectors remain internal.

organization_id.description: Organization that issued and owns this lifecycle record

renewable.description: Whether the governing Credential Template permits renewal.

renewal_eligible_at.description: Earliest time the operator may start renewal.

renewed_from_credential_id.description: Credential superseded by this credential after a successful renewal redemption.

renewed_to_credential_id.description: Replacement credential created by a completed renewal.

revocation_profile_id.description: RevocationProfile governing revocation check mode and caching for this credential.

revocation_reason.description: Reason for revocation; see revocation-reasons enum

status_list_entries.description: References to status list entries (bitstring or token status list)

subject_claims_hash.description: Privacy-preserving SHA-256 hash of subject claims payload (for audit without revealing PII)

subject_id.description: DID, device key, or holder identifier

schemas__issued_credential_lifecycle_req.description: Reason supplied for a tenant-bound issued-credential lifecycle transition.
schemas__issued_credential_lifecycle_req.title: IssuedCredentialLifecycleRequest

publicMetadata.description: Public descriptive metadata. Custody, key-routing, profile, KMS, and provider selectors are prohibited at every depth.

schemas__issuer_entity.description: An organisation or authority that issues credentials. Separate from Trust Anchors (cryptographic roots). An issuer may be backed by one or more trust anchors. Supports full lifecycle: accreditation, suspension, and revocation.

accreditation_body.description: The authority that certified the issuer; this is not evidence of which accreditations the issuer holds.

accreditations.description: Accreditation identifiers held by this issuer. Policy comparison is case-insensitive and requires every requested identifier.

compliance_status.description: ACCREDITED: formally certified by an accreditation body. COMPLIANT: meets required standards. SUSPENDED: temporarily inactive (reversible). REVOKED: permanently invalidated.

is_system_issuer.description: true = automatically visible to all organisations (e.g. ICAO-enrolled states, AAMVA issuers)

issuer_id.description: Unique issuer identifier: DID, domain, X.509 subject DN, or custom ID

issuer_type.description: ORGANIZATION: enterprise issuer. GOVERNMENT: state/national authority. DEVICE: device-bound credential issuer.

organization_id.description: null = global/system issuer (auto-visible to all organisations)

trust_anchor_id.description: Optional link to a trust anchor (for X.509 chain-backed issuers)

accreditations.description: Initial complete set of accreditation identifiers held by this issuer. Defaults to an empty set.

allowed_formats.description: Override allowed formats. null = use framework defaults.

purpose.description: Human-readable consent description shown in the wallet UI during presentation request, e.g. 'Age verification for access control'

schemas__revocation_profile.title: RevocationProfile

schemas__trust_profile.description: Cryptographic trust configuration for credential issuance and verification. Used by both issuance flows (which issuer keys are trusted) and verification flows (which credential issuers/roots are accepted). For org-specific framework overrides, see OrganizationTrustProfile.

allowed_issuers.description: Explicit issuer allowlist. Each entry MAY be a DID, HTTPS issuer URL, or issuer domain. Verifiers SHOULD match exact identifiers and normalized URL/domain aliases. null = allow all not in denied_issuers.

compatible_compliance_codes.description: Compliance codes whose trust requirements this profile satisfies. Enables multiple compliance profiles (e.g., EUDI_PID and EUDI_MDL) to share a single EUDI trust registry. When null or absent, compatibility is inferred from profile_type alone.

denied_issuers.description: Explicit issuer denylist. Each entry MAY be a DID, HTTPS issuer URL, or issuer domain. Checked before allowed_issuers.

profile_type.description: Top-level framework classification. Determines default trust anchors, certificate chain validation rules, and which PKD endpoints to consult.

check_mode.description: HARD_FAIL: reject credential if revocation check fails or is unavailable. SOFT_FAIL: accept with warning if check fails. SKIP: bypass revocation check entirely.

revocation_profile_id.description: Optional reference to a RevocationProfile entity that governs revocation check mode, caching, and grace period. When set, takes precedence over inline revocation_policy configuration.

revocation_services.description: Revocation endpoint configuration for CRL, OCSP, and status list methods

auto_discover.description: Attempt to discover revocation endpoints from credential metadata

merge_discovered.description: Merge auto-discovered endpoints with explicitly configured ones

action.description: DENY: reject credentials from this issuer even though it's a trusted system issuer. DOWNGRADE: reduce trust_level for credentials from this issuer.

trust_level.description: Required when action is DOWNGRADE. Sets an effective trust level below the default 100.

system_issuer_overrides.description: Per-issuer overrides for system issuers (e.g. ICAO-enrolled states). Keyed by issuer_id.

did_resolution.description: DID resolution policy for DID-backed trust sources. The default is fail-closed org-scoped resolution.

organization_id.description: Optional organization scope for DID issuer resolution. When present, verifiers MUST resolve issuer_did through that organization's issuer identity registry before public DID fallback.

registry_sync.description: Optional pull configuration for an external registry that implements the Marty Trust Registry Sync v1 contract. This does not imply support for a registry's native/raw distribution format.

url.description: HTTPS URI for a trust list or a pinned issuer URL. Pinned issuer URLs are useful for web-native badge ecosystems such as Canvas Credentials or Open Badges.

verification_method_ids.description: Optional pinned DID verification method IDs accepted for this issuer DID.

verification_policy_set_id.description: Reference to a PolicySet (policy_type=CREDENTIAL_VERIFICATION) containing Cedar policies for issuer trust decisions. When set, Cedar policies augment the allowed_issuers/denied_issuers lists: Cedar forbid policies act as an additional deny layer, and Cedar permit policies can grant access to issuers not in allowed_issuers.

schemas__trust_profile.title: TrustProfile

schemas__trust_profile_issuer.description: Join entity between TrustProfile and IssuerEntity with trust scoring and cascade revocation policy. trust_level is a 0–100 score; future versions will auto-adjust based on issuer history (failed validations, revocation events, compliance lapses).

cascade_revocation_policy.description: What happens when this issuer is revoked. AUTO_CASCADE: automatically revoke all dependent credentials. MANUAL: queue for manual review. NOTIFY_ONLY: alert affected parties without auto-revoking.

relationship_status.description: TRUSTED: issuer accepted. DENIED: issuer explicitly rejected. UNDER_REVIEW: pending compliance evaluation.

trust_level.description: Trust score 0–100. Consumer policies may require a minimum trust_level via PresentationPolicy.issuer_constraints.min_trust_level.

schemas__trust_profile_issuer.title: TrustProfileIssuer

schemas__trust_profile_issuer_create_req.description: Creates a trust relationship between an existing TrustProfile and IssuerEntity. Issuer identity and lifecycle fields belong to IssuerEntity and are not accepted here.

issuer_id.description: References an existing IssuerEntity.id visible to the trust profile's organization.

schemas__trust_profile_issuer_create_req.title: TrustProfileIssuerCreateRequest

schemas__trust_profile_issuer_update_req.description: Updates trust-relationship policy only. IssuerEntity identity and lifecycle fields are updated through the IssuerEntity API.
schemas__trust_profile_issuer_update_req.title: TrustProfileIssuerUpdateRequest

schemas__verification_flow_start_request.description: Public request to start an OID4VP or SIOPv2 flow using a DID-resolved verifier profile.
schemas__verification_flow_start_request.title: VerificationFlowStartRequest

schemas__verification_flow_start_respons.description: Public response for a newly started verification flow. Internal flow-definition routing is intentionally absent.
schemas__verification_flow_start_respons.title: VerificationFlowStartResponse

schemas__verification_result_response.description: Public result projection for an authorized verification Flow execution.
schemas__verification_result_response.title: VerificationResultResponse

schemas__wallet_profile.description: Wallet compatibility record for a credential format × protocol × compliance combination. The canonical wallet profile set is auto-derived from CredentialTemplate configuration via the derivation key (credential_format, issuance_protocol, compliance_profile_code). Organizations MAY store override entries at /v1/wallet-registry to extend or customise the derived profile for their specific deployment. GET /v1/wallet-registry returns merged results: derived profiles supplemented (or overridden) by stored entries.

deep_link_scheme.description: Optional scheme used by older wallet registry fixtures. Prefer deep_link_pattern for new entries.

format_variant.description: Optional wallet-specific format variant such as dc+sd-jwt or mso_mdoc.

id.description: Unique identifier. Present on stored override entries; absent on derived profiles returned inline.

is_override.description: True when this record is a stored organisation override rather than a system-derived profile. Stored overrides require id and organization_id.

merge_strategy.description: How the wallet_apps and specifications arrays from this override are merged with the derived profile. APPEND adds entries; REPLACE substitutes the entire array.

organization_id.description: Organization that owns this override entry. Null on system-derived profiles.

override_precedence.description: Merge priority for stored overrides relative to the derived profile. Higher values take precedence. Default 50. System-derived entries have effective precedence 0.

wallet_apps.description: Compatible wallet application names. In merged results, override entries append to (or replace) the derived list depending on merge_strategy.

schemas__wallet_profile.title: WalletProfile
